items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: You know George Bush was just dumb but you know not evil.

ctx.x: Okay as of this election cycle Liberals with a capital L are the new conservatives, with a small C because conservatives are radicals. Liberals believe in constitutionality, the rule of law, old fashioned values. Trump supporters — MAGA Republicans are radicals who would overthrow that order and we saw that. That’s not an empty allegation, we saw that on January 6. And to kind of spy on the enemy I’ve kind of listened to Sean Hannity a couple of times and people like that, and read some things, and they keep…

left. I think what they may mean, or try to make us believe applies to Democrats and green-carded people and so forth, are a kind of equally illiberal, woke group that would impose censorship on speech that they don’t agree with. And again, that is not liberal, that is not left, that is just a different kind of authoritarianism. So I think you’re bemused by my observation but just take it as my opinion as American has no left as such. It has opposed authoritarian groupings and that liberals, which I take you to…

Yes, and I think we did take it for granted and I think you should be able to speak like that on CNN. So Darius, thank you for your time today. I wish you the best of luck with all the projects you have going on. I think you chose — whoever chose “Playing the Changes,” the title —
